conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration risk, leading to lower potential drawdowns but also capping upside potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces concentration and leverage while blending broad market exposure with quality tech and income. Drawdowns are expected to be moderate.
